<module id="div_16bit">
    <description>Divides a 16-bit dividend by an 8-bit divisor and outputs the quotient and remainder.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="A" width_description="[15:0]">16-bit dividend.</input>
        <input id="B" width_description="[7:0]">8-bit divisor.</input>
        <output id="result" width_description="[15:0]">16-bit quotient.</output>
        <output id="odd" width_description="[15:0]">16-bit remainder.</output>
    </ports>
    <implementation>Implements the division operation using two always blocks for combinational logic.</implementation>
    <task id="divide_task">
        <description>This task performs the division operation.</description>
        <input id="A" width_description="[15:0]">16-bit dividend.</input>
        <input id="B" width_description="[7:0]">8-bit divisor.</input>
        <output id="result" width_description="[15:0]">16-bit quotient.</output>
        <output id="odd" width_description="[15:0]">16-bit remainder.</output>
        
        <reg id="a_reg" width_description="[15:0]">Register to hold the value of A.</reg>
        <reg id="b_reg" width_description="[7:0]">Register to hold the value of B.</reg>
        <reg id="result_reg" width_description="[15:0]">Register to hold the quotient.</reg>
        <reg id="odd_reg" width_description="[15:0]">Register to hold the remainder.</reg>
        <reg id="count" width_description="[3:0]">Counter to keep track of the number of iterations.</reg>
        <reg id="temp_result" width_description="[15:0]">Temporary register to store the result during each iteration.</reg>
        <reg id="temp_odd" width_description="[15:0]">Temporary register to store the remainder during each iteration.</reg>
        <reg id="diff" width_description="[15:0]">Difference between the extracted bits of A and B.</reg>
        <reg id="carry_in" width_description="[15:0]">Carry-in for the subtraction operation.</reg>
        <reg id="shifted_remainder" width_description="[15:0]">Shifted remainder after each iteration.</reg>
        <reg id="extracted_bits_A" width_description="[15:0]">Extracted bits from A for comparison.</reg>
        <reg id="extracted_bits_B" width_description="[15:0]">Extracted bits from B for comparison.</reg>
        <reg id="quotient_bit" width_description="[15:0]">Bit to be appended to the quotient.</reg>
        <reg id="remainder_bit" width_description="[15:0]">Bit to be appended to the remainder.</reg>
        <reg id="done" width_description="[15:0]">Flag indicating completion of the division operation.</reg>
        <always_comb>
            // Update the registers with the input values
            a_reg = A;
            b_reg = B;
            
            // Initialize variables
            temp_result = 0;
            temp_odd = 0;
            count = 0;
            done = 0;
            
            // Perform the division operation
            while (!done) begin
                // Extract bits from A and B based on the current count
                extracted_bits_A = a_reg >> (15 - count);
                extracted_bits_B = b_reg << count;
                
                // Calculate the difference between the extracted bits
                diff = extracted_bits_A - extracted_bits_B;
                
                // Check if the difference is negative
                if (diff[15]) begin
                    // Set the quotient bit to 0
                    quotient_bit = 0;
                    
                    // Shift the remainder left by 1 bit
                    shifted_remainder = temp_odd << 1;
                    
                    // Append the carry-in bit to the shifted remainder
                    shifted_remainder[count] = carry_in;
                    
                    // Assign the shifted remainder to the temporary remainder
                    temp_odd = shifted_remainder;
                end else begin
                    // Set the quotient bit to 1
                    quotient_bit = 1;
                    
                    // Shift the remainder left by 1 bit
                    shifted_remainder = temp_odd << 1;
                    
                    // Append the carry-in bit to the shifted remainder
                    shifted_remainder[count] = carry_in;
                    
                    // Add the difference to the shifted remainder
                    shifted_remainder = shifted_remainder + diff;
                    
                    // Assign the shifted remainder to the temporary remainder
                    temp_odd = shifted_remainder;
                end
                
                // Append the quotient bit to the result
                temp_result[count] = quotient_bit;
                
                // Increment the count
                count = count + 1;
                
                // Check if all bits have been processed
                if (count == 16) begin
                    done = 1;
                end
            end
            
            // Assign the final results to the output ports
            result_reg = temp_result;
            odd_reg = temp_odd;
        end
        
        <assign result = result_reg;
               odd = odd_reg;
        </assign>
    </task>
    
</module>
